newsitem.title: USA: ORA Electronics to begin Telecar sales.
newsitem.headline: ORA Electronics to begin Telecar sales.

text.p: ORA Electronics Inc on Friday said it will start shipping Telecar, the entry-level model of its Intelligent Transportation System product line, in January.
Telecar connects a cellular telephone directly to a car audio system, giving its user a hands-free system for talking on the cellphone.
It is compatible with several popular cellular telephones and is designed to work with a variety of existing audio systems made by Delco Electronics, which are used in General Motors Corp vehicles.
